description: What it does: Returns compact rows (value, unit, period, geo, source) from free public statistics sources such as World Bank, Eurostat, ECB, BIS, ILO, CDC and USGS. Call it when: you need an official figure, e.g. Korea's GDP in 2023 from the World Bank; you want a public data series without writing your own client for each source. In/out: In: {params} or a short text · Out: rows with source and license (mode direct: a ready request you fetch yourself). Free public data, compact rows to save tokens: query public no-key data APIs - worldbank (The World Bank); eurostat (Eurostat (European Commission)); ecb (European Central Bank); bis (Bank for International Settlements); ilostat (International Labour Organization (ILOSTAT)); clinicaltrials (U.S. National Library of Medicine (ClinicalTrials.gov)); cdc (U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention); usgs-earthquakes (U.S. Geological Survey (ComCat)); unesco-uis (UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)); ssb (Statistics Norway (SSB)); crossref (Crossref); europepmc (Europe PMC (EMBL-EBI)); wikidata (Wikimedia Foundation (Wikidata)); gleif (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF)). Pass connector + params (per-connector params are listed in each agent card: https://agentbazaar.tech/a2a/connectors/<id>/.well-known/agent.json) or a short text. Default mode direct: returns a ready GET request + short extract spec so you fetch the source yourself (no key; cache hit -> instant rows). mode "proxy": we fetch and return compact rows (one line per row "value unit | period | geo | label | id" + source/license; format "rows" for JSON; fields / limit / latest_only shrink it), within per-source budgets. Not affiliated with the data publishers; cite the source line. Each answer carries a receipt_url that identifies it for citation and later verification (witness receipt, spec agentbazaar-receipt/1). It is in the result _meta["agentbazaar.receipt"].

mode.description: direct (default: request + extract spec) or proxy (we fetch)

text.description: or a short text query, e.g. "GDP Korea 2020-2024"

name: public_data
